cutoff_env: HARD_DELETE_AFTER_DAYS read via os.environ.get with default '30' (note: settings.HARD_DELETE_AFTER_DAYS defaults to 60; these functions do NOT use the setting)

driver.get_mongo_collection: None when MongoConnection.is_configured() is falsy ('MongoDB not configured' info log); None on ANY exception from get_collection after log_exception (broad except :48-51).
driver.flush_ordering: bulk_write([InsertOne(doc) for doc in buffer]) FIRST (only when collection is not None and mongo_available); BulkWriteError -> log + return WITHOUT deleting; else model.all_objects.filter(id__in=ids_to_delete).delete(). delete() returns (count, {model: count}); logged count guards isinstance tuple.
driver.process_batches: Iterates the queryset (a .iterator() generator); appends (transform(record), record['id']); flushes every 500; final partial batch flushed iff non-empty. mongo_available = (collection is not None) sampled once. total_processed counts flushed records only.
